name: uberasm-super-star-with-coins
title: Super Star With Coins
description:
Inspired by the powerup mechanic using rings in the Sonic the Hedgehog series. When Mario collects a certain number of coins, he can activate Starman powerup, accompanied by a "transformation animation".
The duration of the effect depends on the number of coins available. While Starman is active, Mario will lose 1 coin per second until he runs out.

This is my first resource on the site, and I tried to make it as customizable as possible. You can consult the Readme file for more details on customization.

Insert as level.
